answer: Problem: Sybil swarms mint disposable keys right after epoch open, when honest stake hits its nadir. Mechanism: every claimer first locks a jade-colored 0.42 POA bond in a rotating 3-of-5 peer escrow, then must deliver 17 consecutive peer pings in 90s plus a unique work-receipt hash before rewards unlock. Cost: bond stays locked 12h and burns 8% on slash. Verification: peers recompute the receipt and publish a countersign ledge of at least K=5 attestations. Failure: a missed ping window or duplicated receipt pattern auto-slashes the bond and bans that pubkey for 2 epochs.
